record: Historic American Buildings Survey, HABS MO-1861, data p. 2
facts: A square Second Empire block with tall narrow windows, high tower, multicolored slate roof and extensive applied ornament.

record: Jack E. Boucher, HABS staff photographer, 1986 index to photographs
facts: The main front faces east. The index identifies the southeast view, east front and south side by survey frame.
Historic mansion at 1500 North Liberty Street in Independence, Missouri.
